summary: At this pivotal moment in American history, let us move forward together to take on and defeat a powerful, greedy and corrupt ruling classWe are at a pivotal moment in history.

stories.title: Amazon’s sale deals deceive customers, thinktank alleges
summary: Two-thirds of Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale products were priced the same or lower in previous months Groundwork Collaborative finds, a claim Amazon disputesAn Apple Watch on sale for $680.

A Carhartt beanie just shy of $20.These discounts – all reportedly featured last year on Amazon’s own curation of its best Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals – sound like good deals for the holiday gift season.

But a recent analysis from progressive thinktank Groundwork Collaborative found these products and others had been listed at the same price or even less just days before Amazon started advertising them as discounted.
